race.comment: DIRTY DANI (6) has the most reliable winning case, having placed at both runs this campaign and gone under by just over a length at Coonabarabran after another close third at Port Macquarie. She is still a maiden, but four placings from five starts and a strong around-1000m profile give her the right credentials in this thin contest. ENTIRELY OAK (1) is the clear danger on consistency, with three placings from three starts at this track and another honest third behind Fred Astern, though his 1000m record keeps the assessment measured. DANLEO (8) is open to improvement after a fair Bathurst debut and has a recent Hawkesbury trial win in the background. No shock to see her play a leading role. STILL THE MOON (4) resumes off two unplaced runs at this venue, yet the inside draw and prior market respect leave him in the minor-winning mix if sharper fresh. Blinkers come off and keep safe.
